title: Fossils Reimagined
description: this is a texture pack for the mod Fossils and Archeology that implements cool designs for some animals
body:
Texture pack for the mod **Fossils And Archeology: Revival** that brings cool designs for some animals of the mod

Animals that have new textures:
- Tyrannosaurus
- Postosuchus

future versions will bring _better textures_ and more textures for other animals
